Package Pickup

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using int64 = long long;
using i128 = __int128_t;

const i128 INF = (i128)1 << 120;

struct Mat {
    i128 a[2][2];
};

Mat identityMat() {
    Mat r;
    r.a[0][0] = r.a[1][1] = 0;
    r.a[0][1] = r.a[1][0] = INF;
    return r;
}

Mat zeroMat() {
    Mat r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++)
            r.a[i][j] = 0;
    return r;
}

bool isIdentity(const Mat &m) {
    return m.a[0][0] == 0 && m.a[1][1] == 0 &&
           m.a[0][1] >= INF / 2 && m.a[1][0] >= INF / 2;
}

Mat multiply(const Mat &a, const Mat &b) {
    if (isIdentity(a)) return b;
    if (isIdentity(b)) return a;
    Mat r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
            r.a[i][j] = INF;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
            if (a.a[i][k] >= INF / 2) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                if (b.a[k][j] >= INF / 2) continue;
                r.a[i][j] = min(r.a[i][j], a.a[i][k] + b.a[k][j]);
            }
        }
    }
    return r;
}

Mat powerMat(Mat a, int64 e) {
    Mat r = identityMat();
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) r = multiply(r, a);
        e >>= 1;
        if (e) a = multiply(a, a);
    }
    return r;
}

void applyMat(const Mat &m, i128 &A, i128 &B) {
    i128 na = INF, nb = INF;
    if (A < INF / 2) {
        if (m.a[0][0] < INF / 2) na = min(na, A + m.a[0][0]);
        if (m.a[0][1] < INF / 2) nb = min(nb, A + m.a[0][1]);
    }
    if (B < INF / 2) {
        if (m.a[1][0] < INF / 2) na = min(na, B + m.a[1][0]);
        if (m.a[1][1] < INF / 2) nb = min(nb, B + m.a[1][1]);
    }
    A = na;
    B = nb;
}

struct Pkg {
    bool empty = true;
    i128 first = 0, last = 0;
    i128 maxGap = 0;
    i128 minU = INF; // min(q_i - 2*q_{i+1})
    i128 minV = INF; // min(2*q_i - q_{i+1})
};

Pkg singlePkg(i128 x) {
    Pkg p;
    p.empty = false;
    p.first = p.last = x;
    return p;
}

Pkg joinPkg(const Pkg &a, const Pkg &b) {
    if (a.empty) return b;
    if (b.empty) return a;
    Pkg r;
    r.empty = false;
    r.first = a.first;
    r.last = b.last;
    r.maxGap = max({a.maxGap, b.maxGap, b.first - a.last});
    r.minU = min({a.minU, b.minU, a.last - 2 * b.first});
    r.minV = min({a.minV, b.minV, 2 * a.last - b.first});
    return r;
}

Pkg shiftPkg(Pkg p, i128 off) {
    if (p.empty) return p;
    p.first += off;
    p.last += off;
    if (p.minU < INF / 2) p.minU -= off;
    if (p.minV < INF / 2) p.minV += off;
    return p;
}

Pkg repeatPkg(const Pkg &p, int64 count, i128 off, int64 M) {
    Pkg result;
    if (p.empty || count == 0) return result;

    Pkg cur = p;
    int64 len = 1;
    int64 done = 0;
    int64 bits = count;

    while (bits > 0) {
        if (bits & 1) {
            result = joinPkg(result,
                             shiftPkg(cur, off + (i128)done * M));
            done += len;
        }
        bits >>= 1;
        if (!bits) break;
        cur = joinPkg(cur, shiftPkg(cur, (i128)len * M));
        len *= 2;
    }
    return result;
}

Mat gapMat(i128 a, i128 b, const Pkg &p) {
    if (p.empty) return zeroMat();

    i128 D = b - a;
    i128 X = b - p.first;
    i128 Y = p.last - a;

    i128 alpha = min(2 * X, Y);
    i128 beta = min(2 * X, 2 * Y);
    i128 gamma = min(X, Y);
    i128 delta = min(X, 2 * Y);

    if (p.first != p.last) {
        alpha = min(alpha, p.minU + 2 * b - a);
        beta = min(beta, 2 * D - 2 * p.maxGap);
        gamma = min(gamma, D - p.maxGap);
        delta = min(delta, p.minV + b - 2 * a);
    }

    Mat m;
    m.a[0][0] = alpha;
    m.a[0][1] = gamma;
    m.a[1][0] = beta;
    m.a[1][1] = delta;
    return m;
}

struct Node {
    bool hasCow = false;
    i128 firstCow = 0, lastCow = 0;
    Pkg pre, post;
    Mat R = identityMat();
};

Node combineNode(const Node &L, const Node &R) {
    Node res;
    res.hasCow = L.hasCow || R.hasCow;

    if (L.hasCow) res.firstCow = L.firstCow;
    else res.firstCow = R.firstCow;

    if (R.hasCow) res.lastCow = R.lastCow;
    else res.lastCow = L.lastCow;

    res.pre = L.hasCow ? L.pre : joinPkg(L.pre, R.pre);
    res.post = R.hasCow ? R.post : joinPkg(L.post, R.post);

    if (L.hasCow && R.hasCow) {
        Pkg between = joinPkg(L.post, R.pre);
        Mat middle = gapMat(L.lastCow, R.firstCow, between);
        res.R = multiply(multiply(L.R, middle), R.R);
    } else if (L.hasCow) {
        res.R = L.R;
    } else if (R.hasCow) {
        res.R = R.R;
    } else {
        res.R = identityMat();
    }
    return res;
}

struct APInterval {
    int type; // 0 cow, 1 package
    int64 startCol, endCol;
    int64 residue;
};

struct Event {
    int64 col;
    int idx;
    int type;
    int delta;
    bool operator<(const Event &other) const {
        return col < other.col;
    }
};

struct SegmentTree {
    int n;
    int64 M;
    vector<int64> coord;
    vector<int> cowCnt, pkgCnt;
    vector<Node> tree;

    SegmentTree(const vector<int64> &coords, int64 m)
        : n((int)coords.size()), M(m), coord(coords),
          cowCnt(coords.size(), 0), pkgCnt(coords.size(), 0),
          tree(4 * coords.size()) {
        build(1, 0, n - 1);
    }

    Node makeLeaf(int pos) {
        Node r;
        if (cowCnt[pos] > 0) {
            r.hasCow = true;
            r.firstCow = r.lastCow = (i128)coord[pos];
            r.R = cowCnt[pos] >= 2 ? zeroMat() : identityMat();
        } else {
            r.hasCow = false;
            Pkg p;
            if (pkgCnt[pos] > 0) p = singlePkg((i128)coord[pos]);
            r.pre = r.post = p;
            r.R = identityMat();
        }
        return r;
    }

    void build(int v, int l, int r) {
        if (l == r) {
            tree[v] = makeLeaf(l);
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        build(v * 2, l, mid);
        build(v * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r);
        tree[v] = combineNode(tree[v * 2], tree[v * 2 + 1]);
    }

    void update(int pos, int type, int delta) {
        if (type == 0) cowCnt[pos] += delta;
        else pkgCnt[pos] += delta;
        update(1, 0, n - 1, pos);
    }

    void update(int v, int l, int r, int pos) {
        if (l == r) {
            tree[v] = makeLeaf(l);
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        if (pos <= mid) update(v * 2, l, mid, pos);
        else update(v * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r, pos);
        tree[v] = combineNode(tree[v * 2], tree[v * 2 + 1]);
    }

    Node root() const {
        return tree[1];
    }
};

void printInt(i128 x) {
    if (x == 0) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return;
    }
    string s;
    while (x > 0) {
        s.push_back(char('0' + x % 10));
        x /= 10;
    }
    reverse(s.begin(), s.end());
    cout << s << '\n';
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int64 M;
    int N, P;
    cin >> M >> N >> P;

    vector<APInterval> intervals;
    vector<int64> residues;
    intervals.reserve(N + P);
    residues.reserve(N + P);

    auto readInterval = [&](int type) {
        int64 L, R;
        cin >> L >> R;
        int64 sc = L / M;
        int64 ec = R / M;
        int64 rem = L % M;
        intervals.push_back({type, sc, ec, rem});
        residues.push_back(rem);
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) readInterval(0);
    for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) readInterval(1);

    sort(residues.begin(), residues.end());
    residues.erase(unique(residues.begin(), residues.end()), residues.end());

    vector<Event> events;
    events.reserve(2 * intervals.size());

    for (const auto &in : intervals) {
        int idx = lower_bound(residues.begin(), residues.end(), in.residue)
                  - residues.begin();
        events.push_back({in.startCol, idx, in.type, 1});
        events.push_back({in.endCol + 1, idx, in.type, -1});
    }

    sort(events.begin(), events.end());
    SegmentTree seg(residues, M);

    bool haveCow = false;
    i128 lastCow = 0;
    i128 A = 0, B = 0;
    Pkg pending;

    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < events.size()) {
        int64 col = events[i].col;
        size_t j = i;
        while (j < events.size() && events[j].col == col) {
            seg.update(events[j].idx, events[j].type, events[j].delta);
            j++;
        }

        if (j == events.size()) break;
        int64 nextCol = events[j].col;
        int64 width = nextCol - col;

        Node root = seg.root();
        i128 off = (i128)col * M;

        if (root.hasCow) {
            Pkg pre = shiftPkg(root.pre, off);
            i128 firstCowPos = off + root.firstCow;

            if (!haveCow) {
                Pkg all = joinPkg(pending, pre);
                i128 x = all.empty ? 0 : firstCowPos - all.first;
                A = 2 * x;
                B = x;
                haveCow = true;
            } else {
                Pkg all = joinPkg(pending, pre);
                Mat boundary = gapMat(lastCow, firstCowPos, all);
                applyMat(boundary, A, B);
            }

            Mat total = root.R;
            if (width > 1) {
                Pkg crossPkg = joinPkg(root.post, shiftPkg(root.pre, M));
                Mat cross = gapMat(root.lastCow, root.firstCow + M, crossPkg);
                Mat period = multiply(root.R, cross);
                total = multiply(powerMat(period, width - 1), root.R);
            }
            applyMat(total, A, B);

            i128 lastOff = ((i128)col + width - 1) * M;
            lastCow = lastOff + root.lastCow;
            pending = shiftPkg(root.post, lastOff);
        } else {
            if (!root.pre.empty) {
                Pkg all = repeatPkg(root.pre, width, off, M);
                pending = joinPkg(pending, all);
            }
        }

        i = j;
    }

    if (!haveCow) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    i128 y = pending.empty ? 0 : pending.last - lastCow;
    i128 answer = min(A + y, B + 2 * y);
    printInt(answer);
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using int64 = long long;
const int64 INF = (int64)4e18;
const int S = 5;
const int WEIGHT[S] = {0, 1, 2, 1, 2};

struct Matrix {
    array<int64, S * S> a;
};

Matrix makeIdentity() {
    Matrix m;
    m.a.fill(INF);
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) m.a[i * S + i] = 0;
    return m;
}

Matrix multiply(const Matrix &A, const Matrix &B) {
    Matrix C;
    C.a.fill(INF);
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < S; k++) {
            int64 x = A.a[i * S + k];
            if (x >= INF) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < S; j++) {
                int64 y = B.a[k * S + j];
                if (y >= INF) continue;
                int64 &dest = C.a[i * S + j];
                dest = min(dest, x + y);
            }
        }
    }
    return C;
}

Matrix addGapBefore(const Matrix &A, int64 gap) {
    Matrix R = A;
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        int64 extra = (int64)WEIGHT[i] * gap;
        for (int j = 0; j < S; j++) {
            int64 &x = R.a[i * S + j];
            if (x < INF) x = min(INF, x + extra);
        }
    }
    return R;
}

array<int64, S> applyMatrix(const array<int64, S> &v, const Matrix &A) {
    array<int64, S> res;
    res.fill(INF);
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        if (v[i] >= INF) continue;
        for (int j = 0; j < S; j++) {
            int64 x = A.a[i * S + j];
            if (x >= INF) continue;
            res[j] = min(res[j], v[i] + x);
        }
    }
    return res;
}

array<int64, S> applyGap(const array<int64, S> &v, int64 gap) {
    array<int64, S> res = v;
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        if (res[i] < INF) {
            res[i] = min(INF, res[i] + (int64)WEIGHT[i] * gap);
        }
    }
    return res;
}

struct SegmentTree {
    int size;
    vector<Matrix> tree;
    Matrix identity;

    SegmentTree(int n) {
        size = 1;
        while (size < n) size <<= 1;
        identity = makeIdentity();
        tree.assign(size << 1, identity);
    }

    void setLeaf(int pos, const Matrix &value) {
        int v = size + pos;
        tree[v] = value;
        for (v >>= 1; v; v >>= 1) {
            tree[v] = multiply(tree[v << 1], tree[v << 1 | 1]);
        }
    }

    Matrix root() const {
        return tree[1];
    }
};

struct RawInterval {
    int64 residue, begin, end;
    int type; // 0 = cow, 1 = package
};

struct Change {
    int64 k;
    int residueIndex;
    int type;
    int delta;
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int64 M;
    int N, P;
    cin >> M >> N >> P;

    vector<RawInterval> intervals;
    intervals.reserve(N + P);
    vector<int64> residues;
    residues.reserve(N + P);

    auto readInterval = [&](int type) {
        int64 L, R;
        cin >> L >> R;
        int64 r = L % M;
        intervals.push_back({r, L / M, R / M, type});
        residues.push_back(r);
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) readInterval(0);
    for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) readInterval(1);

    sort(residues.begin(), residues.end());
    residues.erase(unique(residues.begin(), residues.end()), residues.end());
    int RCount = (int)residues.size();

    vector<Change> changes;
    changes.reserve(2 * intervals.size());
    for (const auto &in : intervals) {
        int idx = (int)(lower_bound(residues.begin(), residues.end(), in.residue)
                        - residues.begin());
        changes.push_back({in.begin, idx, in.type, 1});
        changes.push_back({in.end + 1, idx, in.type, -1});
    }
    sort(changes.begin(), changes.end(),
         [](const Change &a, const Change &b) { return a.k < b.k; });

    // States:
    // 0: no active path
    // 1: active, rooted, currently traversed once
    // 2: active, rooted, currently traversed twice
    // 3: active, unrooted, currently traversed once
    // 4: active, unrooted, currently traversed twice
    Matrix cowEvent = makeIdentity();
    cowEvent.a[0 * S + 1] = 0;
    cowEvent.a[3 * S + 2] = 0;
    cowEvent.a[3 * S + 0] = 0;
    cowEvent.a[4 * S + 1] = 0;

    Matrix packageEvent;
    packageEvent.a.fill(INF);
    packageEvent.a[0 * S + 3] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[0 * S + 4] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[1 * S + 1] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[1 * S + 0] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[2 * S + 2] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[2 * S + 0] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[3 * S + 3] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[4 * S + 4] = 0;

    Matrix identity = makeIdentity();
    Matrix local[3][2];

    for (int cows = 0; cows <= 2; cows++) {
        Matrix cur = identity;
        for (int i = 0; i < cows; i++) cur = multiply(cur, cowEvent);
        local[cows][0] = cur;

        bool first = true;
        Matrix best;
        for (int packagePos = 0; packagePos <= cows; packagePos++) {
            cur = identity;
            for (int i = 0; i < cows; i++) {
                if (i == packagePos) cur = multiply(cur, packageEvent);
                cur = multiply(cur, cowEvent);
            }
            if (packagePos == cows) cur = multiply(cur, packageEvent);

            if (first) {
                best = cur;
                first = false;
            } else {
                for (int j = 0; j < S * S; j++) {
                    best.a[j] = min(best.a[j], cur.a[j]);
                }
            }
        }
        local[cows][1] = best;
    }

    SegmentTree segTree(RCount);
    vector<int> cowCount(RCount, 0), packageCount(RCount, 0);
    set<int> active;
    vector<int> marked;
    marked.reserve(128);

    auto recompute = [&](int idx) {
        if (cowCount[idx] + packageCount[idx] == 0) {
            segTree.setLeaf(idx, identity);
            return;
        }

        int cows = min(cowCount[idx], 2);
        int packages = (packageCount[idx] > 0);
        Matrix value = local[cows][packages];

        auto it = active.lower_bound(idx);
        if (it != active.begin()) {
            int pred = *prev(it);
            int64 gap = residues[idx] - residues[pred];
            value = addGapBefore(value, gap);
        }
        segTree.setLeaf(idx, value);
    };

    array<int64, S> dp;
    dp.fill(INF);
    dp[0] = 0;

    bool hasPrevious = false;
    int64 previousK = 0;
    int previousResidue = -1;

    size_t pos = 0;
    while (pos < changes.size()) {
        int64 k = changes[pos].k;
        size_t end = pos;
        marked.clear();

        while (end < changes.size() && changes[end].k == k) {
            const Change &ch = changes[end];
            int idx = ch.residueIndex;
            marked.push_back(idx);

            auto it = active.lower_bound(idx);
            if (it != active.end()) {
                if (*it == idx) {
                    ++it;
                    if (it != active.end()) marked.push_back(*it);
                } else {
                    marked.push_back(*it);
                }
            }

            bool wasActive = (cowCount[idx] + packageCount[idx] > 0);
            if (ch.type == 0) cowCount[idx] += ch.delta;
            else packageCount[idx] += ch.delta;
            bool nowActive = (cowCount[idx] + packageCount[idx] > 0);

            if (!wasActive && nowActive) active.insert(idx);
            if (wasActive && !nowActive) active.erase(idx);

            it = active.upper_bound(idx);
            if (it != active.end()) marked.push_back(*it);
            ++end;
        }

        sort(marked.begin(), marked.end());
        marked.erase(unique(marked.begin(), marked.end()), marked.end());
        for (int idx : marked) recompute(idx);

        if (!active.empty()) {
            int64 nextK = (end < changes.size() ? changes[end].k : k + 1);
            int64 repetitions = nextK - k;

            int firstIdx = *active.begin();
            int lastIdx = *active.rbegin();

            Matrix period = segTree.root();

            if (hasPrevious) {
                int64 gap = (int64)((__int128)M * (k - previousK)
                                    + residues[firstIdx]
                                    - residues[previousResidue]);
                dp = applyGap(dp, gap);
            }
            dp = applyMatrix(dp, period);

            int64 remaining = repetitions - 1;
            if (remaining > 0) {
                int64 wrapGap = M - residues[lastIdx] + residues[firstIdx];
                Matrix repeated = addGapBefore(period, wrapGap);

                while (remaining > 0) {
                    if (remaining & 1LL) dp = applyMatrix(dp, repeated);
                    remaining >>= 1;
                    if (remaining) repeated = multiply(repeated, repeated);
                }
            }

            hasPrevious = true;
            previousK = k + repetitions - 1;
            previousResidue = lastIdx;
        }

        pos = end;
    }

    cout << dp[0] << '\n';
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
const ll INF = 4000000000000000000LL;
const int S = 5;
const ll W[S] = {0, 1, 2, 1, 2};

struct Mat {
    ll a[S * S];
};

struct Vec {
    ll v[S];
};

static inline Mat multiply(const Mat &A, const Mat &B) {
    Mat C;
    fill(C.a, C.a + S * S, INF);
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < S; k++) {
            ll x = A.a[i * S + k];
            if (x == INF) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < S; j++) {
                ll y = B.a[k * S + j];
                if (y == INF) continue;
                ll z = x + y;
                if (z < C.a[i * S + j]) C.a[i * S + j] = z;
            }
        }
    }
    return C;
}

static inline Vec applyMat(const Vec &v, const Mat &m) {
    Vec out;
    fill(out.v, out.v + S, INF);
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        if (v.v[i] == INF) continue;
        for (int j = 0; j < S; j++) {
            ll x = m.a[i * S + j];
            if (x == INF) continue;
            ll z = v.v[i] + x;
            if (z < out.v[j]) out.v[j] = z;
        }
    }
    return out;
}

/*
States:
0: no active path
1: active weight-1 path, whose cow has not been used yet
2: active weight-2 path, whose cow has not been used yet
3: active weight-1 path, whose cow has already been used
4: active weight-2 path, whose cow has already been used
*/
Mat localTrans[6];

void buildLocalTransitions() {
    for (int cap = 0; cap <= 2; cap++) {
        for (int pkg = 0; pkg <= 1; pkg++) {
            Mat &ans = localTrans[cap * 2 + pkg];
            fill(ans.a, ans.a + S * S, INF);

            for (int initial = 0; initial < S; initial++) {
                bool vis[S][3][2];
                memset(vis, 0, sizeof(vis));
                int q[S * 3 * 2];
                int head = 0, tail = 0;

                auto encode = [](int s, int used, int covered) {
                    return (s * 3 + used) * 2 + covered;
                };

                int initialCovered = (!pkg || initial != 0) ? 1 : 0;
                vis[initial][0][initialCovered] = true;
                q[tail++] = encode(initial, 0, initialCovered);

                while (head < tail) {
                    int code = q[head++];
                    int covered = code & 1;
                    int used = (code / 2) % 3;
                    int s = code / 6;

                    auto relax = [&](int ns, int nu, int nc) {
                        if (!vis[ns][nu][nc]) {
                            vis[ns][nu][nc] = true;
                            q[tail++] = encode(ns, nu, nc);
                        }
                    };

                    if (s == 0) {
                        if (pkg) {
                            relax(1, used, 1);
                            relax(2, used, 1);
                        }
                        if (used < cap) {
                            relax(3, used + 1, 1);
                            if (pkg && !covered) {
                                relax(0, used + 1, 1);
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (s == 1) {
                        if (used < cap) {
                            relax(0, used + 1, 1);
                            relax(4, used + 1, 1);
                        }
                    } else if (s == 2) {
                        if (used < cap) {
                            relax(3, used + 1, 1);
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (pkg) relax(0, used, 1);
                    }
                }

                for (int s = 0; s < S; s++) {
                    for (int used = 0; used <= cap; used++) {
                        for (int covered = 0; covered <= 1; covered++) {
                            if (covered && vis[s][used][covered]) {
                                ans.a[initial * S + s] = 0;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

struct Node {
    Mat m;
    ll first = -1, last = -1;
};

Node mergeNodes(const Node &A, const Node &B) {
    if (A.first < 0) return B;
    if (B.first < 0) return A;

    Node C;
    C.first = A.first;
    C.last = B.last;

    ll distance = B.first - A.last;
    ll extra[S];
    for (int k = 0; k < S; k++) extra[k] = W[k] * distance;

    fill(C.m.a, C.m.a + S * S, INF);
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < S; k++) {
            ll x = A.m.a[i * S + k];
            if (x == INF) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < S; j++) {
                ll y = B.m.a[k * S + j];
                if (y == INF) continue;
                ll base = x + y;
                if (base > INF) continue;
                ll z = base + extra[k];
                if (z < C.m.a[i * S + j]) C.m.a[i * S + j] = z;
            }
        }
    }
    return C;
}

struct SegmentTree {
    int sz;
    vector<Node> tree;

    explicit SegmentTree(int n) {
        sz = 1;
        while (sz < n) sz <<= 1;
        tree.resize(2 * sz);
    }

    void setLeaf(int idx, bool active, ll residue, const Mat &m) {
        int p = idx + sz;
        if (!active) {
            tree[p].first = tree[p].last = -1;
        } else {
            tree[p].first = tree[p].last = residue;
            tree[p].m = m;
        }
        for (p >>= 1; p; p >>= 1) {
            tree[p] = mergeNodes(tree[2 * p], tree[2 * p + 1]);
        }
    }

    Mat periodMatrix(ll M) const {
        Mat result;
        fill(result.a, result.a + S * S, INF);

        const Node &root = tree[1];
        if (root.first < 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
                result.a[i * S + i] = W[i] * M;
            }
            return result;
        }

        ll prefix = root.first;
        ll suffix = M - root.last;
        for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < S; j++) {
                ll x = root.m.a[i * S + j];
                if (x == INF) continue;
                ll z = x + W[i] * prefix + W[j] * suffix;
                result.a[i * S + j] = (z < INF ? z : INF);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
};

bool diagonalMatrix(const Mat &m) {
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < S; j++) {
            if (i != j && m.a[i * S + j] != INF) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void applyMany(Vec &dp, Mat period, ll times) {
    if (diagonalMatrix(period)) {
        for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
            if (dp.v[i] == INF) continue;
            ll cost = period.a[i * S + i];
            if (cost == INF) {
                dp.v[i] = INF;
                continue;
            }
            __int128 z = (__int128)dp.v[i] + (__int128)cost * times;
            dp.v[i] = (z < INF ? (ll)z : INF);
        }
        return;
    }

    if (times <= 16) {
        for (ll i = 0; i < times; i++) dp = applyMat(dp, period);
        return;
    }

    ll e = times;
    while (e) {
        if (e & 1LL) dp = applyMat(dp, period);
        e >>= 1LL;
        if (e) period = multiply(period, period);
    }
}

struct RawInterval {
    ll k1, k2, residue;
    int type;
    int residueIndex;
};

struct Change {
    ll column;
    int residue;
    int type;
    int delta;
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    buildLocalTransitions();

    ll M;
    int N, P;
    cin >> M >> N >> P;

    vector<RawInterval> intervals;
    vector<ll> residues;
    intervals.reserve(N + P);
    residues.reserve(N + P);

    auto readInterval = [&](int type) {
        ll L, R;
        cin >> L >> R;
        RawInterval in;
        in.k1 = L / M;
        in.k2 = R / M;
        in.residue = L % M;
        in.type = type;
        intervals.push_back(in);
        residues.push_back(in.residue);
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) readInterval(0);
    for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) readInterval(1);

    sort(residues.begin(), residues.end());
    residues.erase(unique(residues.begin(), residues.end()), residues.end());
    int R = (int)residues.size();

    vector<Change> changes;
    changes.reserve(2 * intervals.size());

    for (auto &in : intervals) {
        in.residueIndex = (int)(lower_bound(residues.begin(), residues.end(), in.residue)
                                - residues.begin());
        changes.push_back({in.k1, in.residueIndex, in.type, 1});
        changes.push_back({in.k2 + 1, in.residueIndex, in.type, -1});
    }

    sort(changes.begin(), changes.end(), [](const Change &a, const Change &b) {
        return a.column < b.column;
    });

    vector<int> cowCount(R, 0), packageCount(R, 0), marked(R, -1);
    SegmentTree seg(R);

    Vec dp;
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) dp.v[i] = INF;
    dp.v[0] = 0;

    size_t pos = 0;
    int stamp = 0;

    auto applyChangeGroup = [&](ll column) {
        vector<int> dirty;
        int currentStamp = stamp++;

        while (pos < changes.size() && changes[pos].column == column) {
            const Change &ch = changes[pos++];
            if (marked[ch.residue] != currentStamp) {
                marked[ch.residue] = currentStamp;
                dirty.push_back(ch.residue);
            }
            if (ch.type == 0) cowCount[ch.residue] += ch.delta;
            else packageCount[ch.residue] += ch.delta;
        }

        for (int r : dirty) {
            bool active = (cowCount[r] > 0 || packageCount[r] > 0);
            int cap = min(2, cowCount[r]);
            int pkg = (packageCount[r] > 0 ? 1 : 0);
            seg.setLeaf(r, active, residues[r], localTrans[cap * 2 + pkg]);
        }
    };

    ll currentColumn = changes[0].column;
    applyChangeGroup(currentColumn);

    while (pos < changes.size()) {
        ll nextColumn = changes[pos].column;
        Mat period = seg.periodMatrix(M);
        applyMany(dp, period, nextColumn - currentColumn);
        currentColumn = nextColumn;
        applyChangeGroup(currentColumn);
    }

    cout << dp.v[0] << '\n';
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using int64 = long long;
using i128 = __int128_t;

const i128 INF = (i128)1 << 120;

struct Mat {
    i128 a[2][2];
};

Mat identityMat() {
    Mat r;
    r.a[0][0] = r.a[1][1] = 0;
    r.a[0][1] = r.a[1][0] = INF;
    return r;
}

Mat zeroMat() {
    Mat r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++)
            r.a[i][j] = 0;
    return r;
}

bool isIdentity(const Mat &m) {
    return m.a[0][0] == 0 && m.a[1][1] == 0 &&
           m.a[0][1] >= INF / 2 && m.a[1][0] >= INF / 2;
}

Mat multiply(const Mat &a, const Mat &b) {
    if (isIdentity(a)) return b;
    if (isIdentity(b)) return a;
    Mat r;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
            r.a[i][j] = INF;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
            if (a.a[i][k] >= INF / 2) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
                if (b.a[k][j] >= INF / 2) continue;
                r.a[i][j] = min(r.a[i][j], a.a[i][k] + b.a[k][j]);
            }
        }
    }
    return r;
}

Mat powerMat(Mat a, int64 e) {
    Mat r = identityMat();
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) r = multiply(r, a);
        e >>= 1;
        if (e) a = multiply(a, a);
    }
    return r;
}

void applyMat(const Mat &m, i128 &A, i128 &B) {
    i128 na = INF, nb = INF;
    if (A < INF / 2) {
        if (m.a[0][0] < INF / 2) na = min(na, A + m.a[0][0]);
        if (m.a[0][1] < INF / 2) nb = min(nb, A + m.a[0][1]);
    }
    if (B < INF / 2) {
        if (m.a[1][0] < INF / 2) na = min(na, B + m.a[1][0]);
        if (m.a[1][1] < INF / 2) nb = min(nb, B + m.a[1][1]);
    }
    A = na;
    B = nb;
}

struct Pkg {
    bool empty = true;
    i128 first = 0, last = 0;
    i128 maxGap = 0;
    i128 minU = INF; // min(q_i - 2*q_{i+1})
    i128 minV = INF; // min(2*q_i - q_{i+1})
};

Pkg singlePkg(i128 x) {
    Pkg p;
    p.empty = false;
    p.first = p.last = x;
    return p;
}

Pkg joinPkg(const Pkg &a, const Pkg &b) {
    if (a.empty) return b;
    if (b.empty) return a;
    Pkg r;
    r.empty = false;
    r.first = a.first;
    r.last = b.last;
    r.maxGap = max({a.maxGap, b.maxGap, b.first - a.last});
    r.minU = min({a.minU, b.minU, a.last - 2 * b.first});
    r.minV = min({a.minV, b.minV, 2 * a.last - b.first});
    return r;
}

Pkg shiftPkg(Pkg p, i128 off) {
    if (p.empty) return p;
    p.first += off;
    p.last += off;
    if (p.minU < INF / 2) p.minU -= off;
    if (p.minV < INF / 2) p.minV += off;
    return p;
}

Pkg repeatPkg(const Pkg &p, int64 count, i128 off, int64 M) {
    Pkg result;
    if (p.empty || count == 0) return result;

    Pkg cur = p;
    int64 len = 1;
    int64 done = 0;
    int64 bits = count;

    while (bits > 0) {
        if (bits & 1) {
            result = joinPkg(result,
                             shiftPkg(cur, off + (i128)done * M));
            done += len;
        }
        bits >>= 1;
        if (!bits) break;
        cur = joinPkg(cur, shiftPkg(cur, (i128)len * M));
        len *= 2;
    }
    return result;
}

Mat gapMat(i128 a, i128 b, const Pkg &p) {
    if (p.empty) return zeroMat();

    i128 D = b - a;
    i128 X = b - p.first;
    i128 Y = p.last - a;

    i128 alpha = min(2 * X, Y);
    i128 beta = min(2 * X, 2 * Y);
    i128 gamma = min(X, Y);
    i128 delta = min(X, 2 * Y);

    if (p.first != p.last) {
        alpha = min(alpha, p.minU + 2 * b - a);
        beta = min(beta, 2 * D - 2 * p.maxGap);
        gamma = min(gamma, D - p.maxGap);
        delta = min(delta, p.minV + b - 2 * a);
    }

    Mat m;
    m.a[0][0] = alpha;
    m.a[0][1] = gamma;
    m.a[1][0] = beta;
    m.a[1][1] = delta;
    return m;
}

struct Node {
    bool hasCow = false;
    i128 firstCow = 0, lastCow = 0;
    Pkg pre, post;
    Mat R = identityMat();
};

Node combineNode(const Node &L, const Node &R) {
    Node res;
    res.hasCow = L.hasCow || R.hasCow;

    if (L.hasCow) res.firstCow = L.firstCow;
    else res.firstCow = R.firstCow;

    if (R.hasCow) res.lastCow = R.lastCow;
    else res.lastCow = L.lastCow;

    res.pre = L.hasCow ? L.pre : joinPkg(L.pre, R.pre);
    res.post = R.hasCow ? R.post : joinPkg(L.post, R.post);

    if (L.hasCow && R.hasCow) {
        Pkg between = joinPkg(L.post, R.pre);
        Mat middle = gapMat(L.lastCow, R.firstCow, between);
        res.R = multiply(multiply(L.R, middle), R.R);
    } else if (L.hasCow) {
        res.R = L.R;
    } else if (R.hasCow) {
        res.R = R.R;
    } else {
        res.R = identityMat();
    }
    return res;
}

struct APInterval {
    int type; // 0 cow, 1 package
    int64 startCol, endCol;
    int64 residue;
};

struct Event {
    int64 col;
    int idx;
    int type;
    int delta;
    bool operator<(const Event &other) const {
        return col < other.col;
    }
};

struct SegmentTree {
    int n;
    int64 M;
    vector<int64> coord;
    vector<int> cowCnt, pkgCnt;
    vector<Node> tree;

    SegmentTree(const vector<int64> &coords, int64 m)
        : n((int)coords.size()), M(m), coord(coords),
          cowCnt(coords.size(), 0), pkgCnt(coords.size(), 0),
          tree(4 * coords.size()) {
        build(1, 0, n - 1);
    }

    Node makeLeaf(int pos) {
        Node r;
        if (cowCnt[pos] > 0) {
            r.hasCow = true;
            r.firstCow = r.lastCow = (i128)coord[pos];
            r.R = cowCnt[pos] >= 2 ? zeroMat() : identityMat();
        } else {
            r.hasCow = false;
            Pkg p;
            if (pkgCnt[pos] > 0) p = singlePkg((i128)coord[pos]);
            r.pre = r.post = p;
            r.R = identityMat();
        }
        return r;
    }

    void build(int v, int l, int r) {
        if (l == r) {
            tree[v] = makeLeaf(l);
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        build(v * 2, l, mid);
        build(v * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r);
        tree[v] = combineNode(tree[v * 2], tree[v * 2 + 1]);
    }

    void update(int pos, int type, int delta) {
        if (type == 0) cowCnt[pos] += delta;
        else pkgCnt[pos] += delta;
        update(1, 0, n - 1, pos);
    }

    void update(int v, int l, int r, int pos) {
        if (l == r) {
            tree[v] = makeLeaf(l);
            return;
        }
        int mid = (l + r) / 2;
        if (pos <= mid) update(v * 2, l, mid, pos);
        else update(v * 2 + 1, mid + 1, r, pos);
        tree[v] = combineNode(tree[v * 2], tree[v * 2 + 1]);
    }

    Node root() const {
        return tree[1];
    }
};

void printInt(i128 x) {
    if (x == 0) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return;
    }
    string s;
    while (x > 0) {
        s.push_back(char('0' + x % 10));
        x /= 10;
    }
    reverse(s.begin(), s.end());
    cout << s << '\n';
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int64 M;
    int N, P;
    cin >> M >> N >> P;

    vector<APInterval> intervals;
    vector<int64> residues;
    intervals.reserve(N + P);
    residues.reserve(N + P);

    auto readInterval = [&](int type) {
        int64 L, R;
        cin >> L >> R;
        int64 sc = L / M;
        int64 ec = R / M;
        int64 rem = L % M;
        intervals.push_back({type, sc, ec, rem});
        residues.push_back(rem);
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) readInterval(0);
    for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) readInterval(1);

    sort(residues.begin(), residues.end());
    residues.erase(unique(residues.begin(), residues.end()), residues.end());

    vector<Event> events;
    events.reserve(2 * intervals.size());

    for (const auto &in : intervals) {
        int idx = lower_bound(residues.begin(), residues.end(), in.residue)
                  - residues.begin();
        events.push_back({in.startCol, idx, in.type, 1});
        events.push_back({in.endCol + 1, idx, in.type, -1});
    }

    sort(events.begin(), events.end());
    SegmentTree seg(residues, M);

    bool haveCow = false;
    i128 lastCow = 0;
    i128 A = 0, B = 0;
    Pkg pending;

    size_t i = 0;
    while (i < events.size()) {
        int64 col = events[i].col;
        size_t j = i;
        while (j < events.size() && events[j].col == col) {
            seg.update(events[j].idx, events[j].type, events[j].delta);
            j++;
        }

        if (j == events.size()) break;
        int64 nextCol = events[j].col;
        int64 width = nextCol - col;

        Node root = seg.root();
        i128 off = (i128)col * M;

        if (root.hasCow) {
            Pkg pre = shiftPkg(root.pre, off);
            i128 firstCowPos = off + root.firstCow;

            if (!haveCow) {
                Pkg all = joinPkg(pending, pre);
                i128 x = all.empty ? 0 : firstCowPos - all.first;
                A = 2 * x;
                B = x;
                haveCow = true;
            } else {
                Pkg all = joinPkg(pending, pre);
                Mat boundary = gapMat(lastCow, firstCowPos, all);
                applyMat(boundary, A, B);
            }

            Mat total = root.R;
            if (width > 1) {
                Pkg crossPkg = joinPkg(root.post, shiftPkg(root.pre, M));
                Mat cross = gapMat(root.lastCow, root.firstCow + M, crossPkg);
                Mat period = multiply(root.R, cross);
                total = multiply(powerMat(period, width - 1), root.R);
            }
            applyMat(total, A, B);

            i128 lastOff = ((i128)col + width - 1) * M;
            lastCow = lastOff + root.lastCow;
            pending = shiftPkg(root.post, lastOff);
        } else {
            if (!root.pre.empty) {
                Pkg all = repeatPkg(root.pre, width, off, M);
                pending = joinPkg(pending, all);
            }
        }

        i = j;
    }

    if (!haveCow) {
        cout << 0 << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    i128 y = pending.empty ? 0 : pending.last - lastCow;
    i128 answer = min(A + y, B + 2 * y);
    printInt(answer);
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using int64 = long long;
const int64 INF = (int64)4e18;
const int S = 5;
const int WEIGHT[S] = {0, 1, 2, 1, 2};

struct Matrix {
    array<int64, S * S> a;
};

Matrix makeIdentity() {
    Matrix m;
    m.a.fill(INF);
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) m.a[i * S + i] = 0;
    return m;
}

Matrix multiply(const Matrix &A, const Matrix &B) {
    Matrix C;
    C.a.fill(INF);
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < S; k++) {
            int64 x = A.a[i * S + k];
            if (x >= INF) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < S; j++) {
                int64 y = B.a[k * S + j];
                if (y >= INF) continue;
                int64 &dest = C.a[i * S + j];
                dest = min(dest, x + y);
            }
        }
    }
    return C;
}

Matrix addGapBefore(const Matrix &A, int64 gap) {
    Matrix R = A;
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        int64 extra = (int64)WEIGHT[i] * gap;
        for (int j = 0; j < S; j++) {
            int64 &x = R.a[i * S + j];
            if (x < INF) x = min(INF, x + extra);
        }
    }
    return R;
}

array<int64, S> applyMatrix(const array<int64, S> &v, const Matrix &A) {
    array<int64, S> res;
    res.fill(INF);
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        if (v[i] >= INF) continue;
        for (int j = 0; j < S; j++) {
            int64 x = A.a[i * S + j];
            if (x >= INF) continue;
            res[j] = min(res[j], v[i] + x);
        }
    }
    return res;
}

array<int64, S> applyGap(const array<int64, S> &v, int64 gap) {
    array<int64, S> res = v;
    for (int i = 0; i < S; i++) {
        if (res[i] < INF) {
            res[i] = min(INF, res[i] + (int64)WEIGHT[i] * gap);
        }
    }
    return res;
}

struct SegmentTree {
    int size;
    vector<Matrix> tree;
    Matrix identity;

    SegmentTree(int n) {
        size = 1;
        while (size < n) size <<= 1;
        identity = makeIdentity();
        tree.assign(size << 1, identity);
    }

    void setLeaf(int pos, const Matrix &value) {
        int v = size + pos;
        tree[v] = value;
        for (v >>= 1; v; v >>= 1) {
            tree[v] = multiply(tree[v << 1], tree[v << 1 | 1]);
        }
    }

    Matrix root() const {
        return tree[1];
    }
};

struct RawInterval {
    int64 residue, begin, end;
    int type; // 0 = cow, 1 = package
};

struct Change {
    int64 k;
    int residueIndex;
    int type;
    int delta;
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int64 M;
    int N, P;
    cin >> M >> N >> P;

    vector<RawInterval> intervals;
    intervals.reserve(N + P);
    vector<int64> residues;
    residues.reserve(N + P);

    auto readInterval = [&](int type) {
        int64 L, R;
        cin >> L >> R;
        int64 r = L % M;
        intervals.push_back({r, L / M, R / M, type});
        residues.push_back(r);
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) readInterval(0);
    for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) readInterval(1);

    sort(residues.begin(), residues.end());
    residues.erase(unique(residues.begin(), residues.end()), residues.end());
    int RCount = (int)residues.size();

    vector<Change> changes;
    changes.reserve(2 * intervals.size());
    for (const auto &in : intervals) {
        int idx = (int)(lower_bound(residues.begin(), residues.end(), in.residue)
                        - residues.begin());
        changes.push_back({in.begin, idx, in.type, 1});
        changes.push_back({in.end + 1, idx, in.type, -1});
    }
    sort(changes.begin(), changes.end(),
         [](const Change &a, const Change &b) { return a.k < b.k; });

    // States:
    // 0: no active path
    // 1: active, rooted, currently traversed once
    // 2: active, rooted, currently traversed twice
    // 3: active, unrooted, currently traversed once
    // 4: active, unrooted, currently traversed twice
    Matrix cowEvent = makeIdentity();
    cowEvent.a[0 * S + 1] = 0;
    cowEvent.a[3 * S + 2] = 0;
    cowEvent.a[3 * S + 0] = 0;
    cowEvent.a[4 * S + 1] = 0;

    Matrix packageEvent;
    packageEvent.a.fill(INF);
    packageEvent.a[0 * S + 3] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[0 * S + 4] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[1 * S + 1] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[1 * S + 0] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[2 * S + 2] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[2 * S + 0] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[3 * S + 3] = 0;
    packageEvent.a[4 * S + 4] = 0;

    Matrix identity = makeIdentity();
    Matrix local[3][2];

    for (int cows = 0; cows <= 2; cows++) {
        Matrix cur = identity;
        for (int i = 0; i < cows; i++) cur = multiply(cur, cowEvent);
        local[cows][0] = cur;

        bool first = true;
        Matrix best;
        for (int packagePos = 0; packagePos <= cows; packagePos++) {
            cur = identity;
            for (int i = 0; i < cows; i++) {
                if (i == packagePos) cur = multiply(cur, packageEvent);
                cur = multiply(cur, cowEvent);
            }
            if (packagePos == cows) cur = multiply(cur, packageEvent);

            if (first) {
                best = cur;
                first = false;
            } else {
                for (int j = 0; j < S * S; j++) {
                    best.a[j] = min(best.a[j], cur.a[j]);
                }
            }
        }
        local[cows][1] = best;
    }

    SegmentTree segTree(RCount);
    vector<int> cowCount(RCount, 0), packageCount(RCount, 0);
    set<int> active;
    vector<int> marked;
    marked.reserve(128);

    auto recompute = [&](int idx) {
        if (cowCount[idx] + packageCount[idx] == 0) {
            segTree.setLeaf(idx, identity);
            return;
        }

        int cows = min(cowCount[idx], 2);
        int packages = (packageCount[idx] > 0);
        Matrix value = local[cows][packages];

        auto it = active.lower_bound(idx);
        if (it != active.begin()) {
            int pred = *prev(it);
            int64 gap = residues[idx] - residues[pred];
            value = addGapBefore(value, gap);
        }
        segTree.setLeaf(idx, value);
    };

    array<int64, S> dp;
    dp.fill(INF);
    dp[0] = 0;

    bool hasPrevious = false;
    int64 previousK = 0;
    int previousResidue = -1;

    size_t pos = 0;
    while (pos < changes.size()) {
        int64 k = changes[pos].k;
        size_t end = pos;
        marked.clear();

        while (end < changes.size() && changes[end].k == k) {
            const Change &ch = changes[end];
            int idx = ch.residueIndex;
            marked.push_back(idx);

            auto it = active.lower_bound(idx);
            if (it != active.end()) {
                if (*it == idx) {
                    ++it;
                    if (it != active.end()) marked.push_back(*it);
                } else {
                    marked.push_back(*it);
                }
            }

            bool wasActive = (cowCount[idx] + packageCount[idx] > 0);
            if (ch.type == 0) cowCount[idx] += ch.delta;
            else packageCount[idx] += ch.delta;
            bool nowActive = (cowCount[idx] + packageCount[idx] > 0);

            if (!wasActive && nowActive) active.insert(idx);
            if (wasActive && !nowActive) active.erase(idx);

            it = active.upper_bound(idx);
            if (it != active.end()) marked.push_back(*it);
            ++end;
        }

        sort(marked.begin(), marked.end());
        marked.erase(unique(marked.begin(), marked.end()), marked.end());
        for (int idx : marked) recompute(idx);

        if (!active.empty()) {
            int64 nextK = (end < changes.size() ? changes[end].k : k + 1);
            int64 repetitions = nextK - k;

            int firstIdx = *active.begin();
            int lastIdx = *active.rbegin();

            Matrix period = segTree.root();

            if (hasPrevious) {
                int64 gap = (int64)((__int128)M * (k - previousK)
                                    + residues[firstIdx]
                                    - residues[previousResidue]);
                dp = applyGap(dp, gap);
            }
            dp = applyMatrix(dp, period);

            int64 remaining = repetitions - 1;
            if (remaining > 0) {
                int64 wrapGap = M - residues[lastIdx] + residues[firstIdx];
                Matrix repeated = addGapBefore(period, wrapGap);

                while (remaining > 0) {
                    if (remaining & 1LL) dp = applyMatrix(dp, repeated);
                    remaining >>= 1;
                    if (remaining) repeated = multiply(repeated, repeated);
                }
            }

            hasPrevious = true;
            previousK = k + repetitions - 1;
            previousResidue = lastIdx;
        }

        pos = end;
    }

    cout << dp[0] << '\n';
    return 0;
}

using int64 = long long;
using i128 = __int128_t;

static const int64 INF = (int64)4e18;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int64 M;
    int N, P;
    cin >> M >> N >> P;

    vector<int64> cows, packages;
    cows.reserve(N);
    packages.reserve(P);

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        int64 L, R;
        cin >> L >> R;
        for (int64 x = L;; x += M) {
            cows.push_back(x);
            if (x == R) break;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < P; ++i) {
        int64 A, B;
        cin >> A >> B;
        for (int64 x = A;; x += M) {
            packages.push_back(x);
            if (x == B) break;
        }
    }

    sort(cows.begin(), cows.end());
    sort(packages.begin(), packages.end());

    const int C = (int)cows.size();
    const int K = (int)packages.size();

    vector<int64> prev(K + 1, INF), cur(K + 1, INF);
    prev[0] = 0;

    auto clamp = [](i128 x) -> int64 {
        if (x >= INF) return INF;
        if (x <= -INF) return -INF;
        return (int64)x;
    };

    for (int ci = 0; ci < C; ++ci) {
        const int64 s = cows[ci];

        int leftLimit = (int)(upper_bound(packages.begin(), packages.end(), s)
                              - packages.begin());
        int rightStart = (int)(lower_bound(packages.begin(), packages.end(), s)
                               - packages.begin());

        int64 bestRight = INF;
        int64 bestLeftLE = INF;
        int64 bestLeftGE = INF;

        cur[0] = 0;

        for (int j = 1; j <= K; ++j) {
            int k = j - 1;

            i128 br = (i128)prev[k] - packages[k];
            bestRight = min(bestRight, clamp(br));

            if (k < leftLimit) {
                i128 v = (i128)prev[k] - 2 * (i128)packages[k];
                bestLeftLE = min(bestLeftLE, clamp(v));
            }

            if (k >= rightStart) {
                i128 v = (i128)prev[k] + packages[k];
                bestLeftGE = min(bestLeftGE, clamp(v));
            }

            int64 best = prev[j];
            const int64 pj = packages[j - 1];

            if (bestRight < INF) {
                i128 v = (i128)bestRight + pj + llabs(s - pj);
                best = min(best, clamp(v));
            }

            i128 left = INF;
            if (bestLeftLE < INF) {
                left = min(left, (i128)pj + s + bestLeftLE);
            }
            if (bestLeftGE < INF) {
                left = min(left, (i128)pj - s + bestLeftGE);
            }
            if (left < INF) {
                best = min(best, clamp(left));
            }

            cur[j] = best;
        }

        prev.swap(cur);
    }

    cout << prev[K] << '\n';
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
const ll INF = 4'000'000'000'000'000'000LL;

struct Matrix {
    ll a[5][5];
    Matrix() {
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++)
                a[i][j] = INF;
    }
};

Matrix identity() {
    Matrix I;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) I.a[i][i] = 0;
    return I;
}

Matrix makeGap(ll d) {
    Matrix M;
    M.a[0][0] = 0;
    M.a[1][1] = 2 * d;
    M.a[2][2] = 1 * d;
    M.a[3][3] = 1 * d;
    M.a[4][4] = 2 * d;
    M.a[3][0] = 0;
    M.a[4][0] = 0;
    return M;
}

Matrix mul(const Matrix& A, const Matrix& B) {
    Matrix C;
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
            if (A.a[i][k] >= INF / 2) continue;
            ll aik = A.a[i][k];
            for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
                if (B.a[k][j] >= INF / 2) continue;
                ll val = aik + B.a[k][j];
                if (val < C.a[i][j]) C.a[i][j] = val;
            }
        }
    }
    return C;
}

array<ll, 5> vecMul(const array<ll, 5>& v, const Matrix& M) {
    array<ll, 5> res;
    res.fill(INF);
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        if (v[i] >= INF / 2) continue;
        for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++) {
            if (M.a[i][j] >= INF / 2) continue;
            ll val = v[i] + M.a[i][j];
            if (val < res[j]) res[j] = val;
        }
    }
    return res;
}

array<ll, 5> applyPower(array<ll, 5> v, const Matrix& T, ll len) {
    if (len == 0) return v;
    if (len == 1) return vecMul(v, T);
    Matrix base = T;
    while (len > 0) {
        if (len & 1) v = vecMul(v, base);
        len >>= 1;
        if (len) base = mul(base, base);
    }
    return v;
}

struct Event {
    ll k;
    ll r;
    int type; // 0 = cow, 1 = package
    int delta;
    int idx;
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll M;
    int N, P;
    cin >> M >> N >> P;

    vector<Event> events;
    vector<ll> offs;
    offs.push_back(0);

    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
        ll L, R;
        cin >> L >> R;
        ll r = L % M;
        ll k0 = L / M;
        ll len = (R - L) / M + 1;
        ll k1 = k0 + len;
        events.push_back({k0, r, 0, 1, 0});
        events.push_back({k1, r, 0, -1, 0});
        offs.push_back(r);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) {
        ll A, B;
        cin >> A >> B;
        ll r = A % M;
        ll k0 = A / M;
        ll len = (B - A) / M + 1;
        ll k1 = k0 + len;
        events.push_back({k0, r, 1, 1, 0});
        events.push_back({k1, r, 1, -1, 0});
        offs.push_back(r);
    }

    sort(offs.begin(), offs.end());
    offs.erase(unique(offs.begin(), offs.end()), offs.end());
    offs.push_back(M); // sentinel for the end of a period

    int K = (int)offs.size();

    for (auto& ev : events) {
        ev.idx = (int)(lower_bound(offs.begin(), offs.end(), ev.r) - offs.begin());
    }

    sort(events.begin(), events.end(), [](const Event& a, const Event& b) {
        return a.k < b.k;
    });

    // Precompute local transition matrices for 0..2 cows and 0..1 package
    Matrix G0 = makeGap(0);

    Matrix tokenP;
    tokenP.a[0][1] = 0; // N  -> BR
    tokenP.a[0][2] = 0; // N  -> BL
    tokenP.a[1][1] = 0; // BR -> BR
    tokenP.a[2][2] = 0; // BL -> BL
    tokenP.a[3][3] = 0; // AR -> AR
    tokenP.a[4][4] = 0; // AL -> AL

    Matrix tokenC = identity();
    tokenC.a[0][3] = 0; // N  -> AR
    tokenC.a[0][4] = 0; // N  -> AL
    tokenC.a[1][3] = 0; // BR -> AR
    tokenC.a[2][4] = 0; // BL -> AL

    Matrix local[3][2];
    Matrix I = identity();

    for (int c = 0; c <= 2; c++) {
        for (int p = 0; p <= 1; p++) {
            if (c == 0 && p == 0) {
                local[c][p] = I;
                continue;
            }

            vector<int> tokens;
            for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) tokens.push_back(0); // cow
            for (int i = 0; i < p; i++) tokens.push_back(1); // package
            sort(tokens.begin(), tokens.end());

            Matrix best;
            do {
                Matrix mat = I;
                for (int t : tokens) {
                    mat = mul(mat, G0);
                    if (t == 0) mat = mul(mat, tokenC);
                    else mat = mul(mat, tokenP);

                mat = mul(mat, G0);

                for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
                    for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++)
                        if (mat.a[i][j] < best.a[i][j])
                            best.a[i][j] = mat.a[i][j];

            local[c][p] = best;
        }
    }

    vector<Matrix> gapMat(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
        ll prev = (i == 0 ? 0 : offs[i - 1]);
        ll d = offs[i] - prev;
        gapMat[i] = makeGap(d);

    int size = 1;

    vector<Matrix> seg(2 * size);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {

    for (int i = K; i < size; i++) {

    for (int i = size - 1; i >= 1; i--) {

    vector<int> cowCnt(K, 0), pkgCnt(K, 0);
    vector<int> curC(K, 0), curP(K, 0);

    auto updateOffset = [&](int idx) {
        if (idx >= K - 1) return; // sentinel never changes
        int c = min(cowCnt[idx], 2);
        int p = (pkgCnt[idx] > 0 ? 1 : 0);
        if (c == curC[idx] && p == curP[idx]) return;

        curC[idx] = c;
        curP[idx] = p;

        Matrix L = local[c][p];
        Matrix A = mul(gapMat[idx], L);

        int pos = size + idx;
        seg[pos] = A;
        for (pos >>= 1; pos >= 1; pos >>= 1) {

            if (pos == 1) break;
        }
    };

    while (eidx < (int)events.size()) {
        ll k = events[eidx].k;

        if (cur_k < k) {

            Event& ev = events[eidx];
            if (ev.type == 0) cowCnt[ev.idx] += ev.delta;
            else pkgCnt[ev.idx] += ev.delta;
            updateOffset(ev.idx);
            eidx++;

    }

void print_i128(i128 x) {

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using int64 = long long;

static constexpr int S = 5;
static constexpr int64 INF = 4'000'000'000'000'000'000LL;

/*
    States:
      0: no active route
      1: active route, cow not encountered, swept part traversed once
      2: active route, cow not encountered, swept part traversed twice
      3: active route, cow encountered, future part traversed once
      4: active route, cow encountered, future part traversed twice
*/

struct Matrix {
    int64 a[S][S];
};

Matrix identityMatrix() {
    Matrix m;
    for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j) {
            m.a[i][j] = (i == j ? 0 : INF);
        }
    }
    return m;
}

/*
    Min-plus matrix multiplication.

    Matrices describe transitions from row states to column states.
    multiply(A, B) means: first apply A, then apply B.
*/
inline Matrix multiply(const Matrix& A, const Matrix& B) {
    Matrix C;

    for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j) {
            int64 v = A.a[i][0] + B.a[0][j];
            if (v > INF) v = INF;
            v = min(v, A.a[i][1] + B.a[1][j]);
            v = min(v, A.a[i][2] + B.a[2][j]);
            v = min(v, A.a[i][3] + B.a[3][j]);
            v = min(v, A.a[i][4] + B.a[4][j]);
            C.a[i][j] = v;
        }
    }

    return C;
}

inline array<int64, S> applyMatrix(const array<int64, S>& v, const Matrix& M) {
    array<int64, S> result;
    result.fill(INF);

    for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j) {
        for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) {
            result[j] = min(result[j], v[i] + M.a[i][j]);
        }
    }

    return result;
}

Matrix makePackageMatrix() {
    Matrix m;
    for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j) {
            m.a[i][j] = INF;
        }
    }

    // With no active route, a package starts a new route.
    m.a[0][1] = 0;
    m.a[0][2] = 0;

    // A route waiting for its cow remains waiting.
    m.a[1][1] = 0;
    m.a[2][2] = 0;

    /*
        A route whose cow is already known may:
          - remain active,
          - end here,
          - end here and a new route start at this package.
    */
    m.a[3][3] = 0;
    m.a[3][0] = 0;
    m.a[3][1] = 0;
    m.a[3][2] = 0;

    m.a[4][4] = 0;
    m.a[4][0] = 0;
    m.a[4][1] = 0;
    m.a[4][2] = 0;

    return m;
}

Matrix makeCowMatrix() {
    Matrix m;
    for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j) {
            m.a[i][j] = INF;
        }
    }

    // Ignore this cow, or start a route with it.
    m.a[0][0] = 0;
    m.a[0][3] = 0;

    /*
        If waiting for a cow:
          - ignore this cow,
          - use this cow and continue,
          - use this cow and immediately end the route.
    */
    m.a[1][1] = 0;
    m.a[1][4] = 0;
    m.a[1][0] = 0;

    m.a[2][2] = 0;
    m.a[2][3] = 0;
    m.a[2][0] = 0;

    // A route with an assigned cow may continue or end.
    m.a[3][3] = 0;
    m.a[3][0] = 0;
    m.a[4][4] = 0;
    m.a[4][0] = 0;

    return m;
}

class SegmentTree {
private:
    int size;
    vector<Matrix> tree;

public:
    explicit SegmentTree(const vector<Matrix>& leaves) {
        size = 1;
        while (size < (int)leaves.size()) size <<= 1;

        tree.resize(2 * size);

        Matrix id = identityMatrix();
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)leaves.size(); ++i) {
            tree[size + i] = leaves[i];
        }
        for (int i = (int)leaves.size(); i < size; ++i) {
            tree[size + i] = id;
        }

        for (int i = size - 1; i >= 1; --i) {
            tree[i] = multiply(tree[i << 1], tree[i << 1 | 1]);
        }
    }

    void update(int position, const Matrix& value) {
        int p = size + position;
        tree[p] = value;

        for (p >>= 1; p >= 1; p >>= 1) {
            tree[p] = multiply(tree[p << 1], tree[p << 1 | 1]);
        }
    }

    const Matrix& product() const {
        return tree[1];
    }
};

struct Event {
    int64 q;
    int residueIndex;
    int cowDelta;
    int packageDelta;

    bool operator<(const Event& other) const {
        return q < other.q;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int64 M;
    int N, P;
    cin >> M >> N >> P;

    vector<int64> cowL(N), cowR(N);
    vector<int64> packageL(P), packageR(P);

    vector<int64> residues;
    residues.reserve(N + P);

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        cin >> cowL[i] >> cowR[i];
        residues.push_back(cowL[i] % M);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < P; ++i) {
        cin >> packageL[i] >> packageR[i];
        residues.push_back(packageL[i] % M);
    }

    sort(residues.begin(), residues.end());
    residues.erase(unique(residues.begin(), residues.end()), residues.end());

    int K = (int)residues.size();

    auto residueIndex = [&](int64 r) -> int {
        return int(lower_bound(residues.begin(), residues.end(), r) - residues.begin());
    };

    vector<Event> events;
    events.reserve(2 * (N + P));

    vector<int> totalCowIntervals(K, 0);

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        int idx = residueIndex(cowL[i] % M);
        int64 qL = cowL[i] / M;
        int64 qR = cowR[i] / M;

        ++totalCowIntervals[idx];

        events.push_back({qL, idx, +1, 0});
        events.push_back({qR + 1, idx, -1, 0});
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < P; ++i) {
        int idx = residueIndex(packageL[i] % M);
        int64 qL = packageL[i] / M;
        int64 qR = packageR[i] / M;

        events.push_back({qL, idx, 0, +1});
        events.push_back({qR + 1, idx, 0, -1});
    }

    sort(events.begin(), events.end());

    int maxCowCount = 0;
    for (int x : totalCowIntervals) {
        maxCowCount = max(maxCowCount, x);
    }

    Matrix cowMatrix = makeCowMatrix();
    Matrix packageMatrix = makePackageMatrix();

    // cowPower[c] represents processing c cows at the same coordinate.
    vector<Matrix> cowPower(maxCowCount + 1);
    cowPower[0] = identityMatrix();
    for (int c = 1; c <= maxCowCount; ++c) {
        cowPower[c] = multiply(cowPower[c - 1], cowMatrix);
    }

    vector<int> cowCount(K, 0);
    vector<int> packageCount(K, 0);

    // Multipliers charged while sweeping across a gap.
    const int gapMultiplier[S] = {0, 1, 2, 1, 2};

    auto makeLeafMatrix = [&](int idx) -> Matrix {
        int c = cowCount[idx];
        bool hasPackage = packageCount[idx] > 0;

        Matrix result;
        if (hasPackage) {
            if (c == 0) {
                result = packageMatrix;
            } else {
                result = multiply(packageMatrix, cowPower[c]);
            }
        } else {
            if (c == 0) {
                result = identityMatrix();
            } else {
                result = cowPower[c];
            }
        }

        // Charge the distance to the next candidate residue.
        if (idx + 1 < K) {
            int64 distance = residues[idx + 1] - residues[idx];
            for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j) {
                    if (result.a[i][j] >= INF) continue;

                    int64 extra = distance * gapMultiplier[j];
                    result.a[i][j] =
                        min(INF, result.a[i][j] + extra);
                }
            }
        }

        return result;
    };

    vector<Matrix> leaves(K);
    for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
        leaves[i] = makeLeafMatrix(i);
    }

    SegmentTree segTree(leaves);

    // Gap from the last candidate residue of one block to the first of the next.
    int64 crossBlockDistance = M + residues.front() - residues.back();

    Matrix crossGap;
    for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j) {
            crossGap.a[i][j] = INF;
        }
        crossGap.a[i][i] =
            min(INF, crossBlockDistance * gapMultiplier[i]);
    }

    array<int64, S> dp;
    dp.fill(INF);
    dp[0] = 0;

    auto applyPower = [&](Matrix base, int64 exponent) {
        while (exponent > 0) {
            if (exponent & 1LL) {
                dp = applyMatrix(dp, base);
            }

            exponent >>= 1;
            if (exponent > 0) {
                base = multiply(base, base);
            }
        }
    };

    vector<int> touched;
    touched.reserve(events.size());

    size_t eventPos = 0;
    bool built = false;

    while (eventPos < events.size()) {
        int64 currentQ = events[eventPos].q;
        touched.clear();

        while (eventPos < events.size() && events[eventPos].q == currentQ) {
            const Event& e = events[eventPos];

            cowCount[e.residueIndex] += e.cowDelta;
            packageCount[e.residueIndex] += e.packageDelta;

            touched.push_back(e.residueIndex);
            ++eventPos;
        }

        sort(touched.begin(), touched.end());
        touched.erase(unique(touched.begin(), touched.end()), touched.end());

        if (!built) {
            for (int idx = 0; idx < K; ++idx) {
                leaves[idx] = makeLeafMatrix(idx);

            segTree = SegmentTree(leaves);
            built = true;

            for (int idx : touched) {

            Matrix blockMatrix = multiply(segTree.product(), crossGap);

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using int64 = long long;
using i128 = __int128_t;

static constexpr int64 INF = 4'000'000'000'000'000'000LL;

int64 clampValue(i128 x) {
    if (x > INF) return INF;
    if (x < -INF) return -INF;
    return static_cast<int64>(x);
}

struct Matrix {
    int64 a[2][2];

    Matrix(bool identity = false) {
        if (identity) {
            a[0][0] = a[1][1] = 0;
            a[0][1] = a[1][0] = INF;
        } else {
            for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j)
                    a[i][j] = INF;
        }
    }
};

// Returns the matrix representing: first apply A, then apply B.
Matrix compose(const Matrix& A, const Matrix& B) {
    Matrix C;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j) {
            i128 best = (i128)INF;
            for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) {
                if (A.a[k][j] >= INF || B.a[i][k] >= INF) continue;
                best = min(best, (i128)A.a[k][j] + B.a[i][k]);
            }
            C.a[i][j] = clampValue(best);
        }
    }
    return C;
}

Matrix matrixPower(Matrix base, int64 exponent) {
    Matrix result(true);
    while (exponent > 0) {
        if (exponent & 1) result = compose(result, base);
        base = compose(base, base);
        exponent >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

struct State {
    int64 x = INF;
    int64 y = INF;
};

State applyMatrix(const Matrix& A, const State& s) {
    State result;
    result.x = clampValue(min((i128)A.a[0][0] + s.x,
                               (i128)A.a[0][1] + s.y));
    result.y = clampValue(min((i128)A.a[1][0] + s.x,
                               (i128)A.a[1][1] + s.y));
    return result;
}

struct PackageSummary {
    bool empty = true;
    int64 first = 0;
    int64 last = 0;
    int64 maxGap = 0;
    int64 minE1 = INF;
    int64 minE2 = INF;
};

PackageSummary mergePackageSummary(const PackageSummary& A,
                                   const PackageSummary& B) {
    if (A.empty) return B;
    if (B.empty) return A;

    PackageSummary C;
    C.empty = false;
    C.first = A.first;
    C.last = B.last;

    int64 gap = B.first - A.first;
    C.maxGap = max({A.maxGap, B.maxGap, gap});
    C.minE1 = min({A.minE1, B.minE1, 2 * A.first - B.first});
    C.minE2 = min({A.minE2, B.minE2, A.first - 2 * B.first});
    return C;
}

class PackageSegmentTree {
    int n;
    vector<PackageSummary> tree;

    void update(int node, int left, int right, int position, bool present) {
        if (left == right) {
            if (present) {
                tree[node].empty = false;
                tree[node].first = tree[node].last = left;
                tree[node].maxGap = 0;
                tree[node].minE1 = INF;
                tree[node].minE2 = INF;
            } else {
                tree[node] = PackageSummary();
            }
            return;
        }

        int middle = (left + right) / 2;
        if (position <= middle)
            update(node * 2, left, middle, position, present);
        else
            update(node * 2 + 1, middle + 1, right, position, present);

        tree[node] = mergePackageSummary(tree[node * 2], tree[node * 2 + 1]);
    }

    PackageSummary query(int node, int left, int right,
                         int queryLeft, int queryRight) const {
        if (queryRight < left || right < queryLeft || queryLeft > queryRight)
            return PackageSummary();

        if (queryLeft <= left && right <= queryRight)
            return tree[node];

        int middle = (left + right) / 2;
        PackageSummary A = query(node * 2, left, middle, queryLeft, queryRight);
        PackageSummary B = query(node * 2 + 1, middle + 1, right,
                                 queryLeft, queryRight);
        return mergePackageSummary(A, B);
    }

public:
    explicit PackageSegmentTree(int size) : n(size), tree(4 * max(1, size)) {}

    void setPresent(int position, bool present) {
        if (n > 0) update(1, 0, n - 1, position, present);
    }

    PackageSummary query(int left, int right) const {
        if (n == 0 || left > right) return PackageSummary();
        return query(1, 0, n - 1, left, right);
    }
};

class MatrixSegmentTree {
    int n;
    vector<Matrix> tree;

    void update(int node, int left, int right, int position,
                const Matrix& value) {
        if (left == right) {
            tree[node] = value;
            return;
        }

        int middle = (left + right) / 2;
        if (position <= middle)
            update(node * 2, left, middle, position, value);
        else
            update(node * 2 + 1, middle + 1, right, position, value);

        tree[node] = compose(tree[node * 2], tree[node * 2 + 1]);
    }

    Matrix query(int node, int left, int right,
                 int queryLeft, int queryRight) const {
        if (queryRight < left || right < queryLeft || queryLeft > queryRight)
            return Matrix(true);

        if (queryLeft <= left && right <= queryRight)
            return tree[node];

        int middle = (left + right) / 2;
        Matrix A = query(node * 2, left, middle, queryLeft, queryRight);
        Matrix B = query(node * 2 + 1, middle + 1, right,
                         queryLeft, queryRight);
        return compose(A, B);
    }

public:
    explicit MatrixSegmentTree(int size)
        : n(size), tree(4 * max(1, size), Matrix(true)) {}

    void setValue(int position, const Matrix& value) {
        if (n > 0) update(1, 0, n - 1, position, value);
    }

    Matrix query(int left, int right) const {
        if (n == 0 || left > right) return Matrix(true);
        return query(1, 0, n - 1, left, right);
    }
};

struct PointSequence {
    bool empty = true;
    int64 first = 0;
    int64 last = 0;
    int64 maxGap = 0;
    int64 minE1 = INF;
    int64 minE2 = INF;
};

void addEdgeExtremes(PointSequence& sequence, int64 left, int64 right) {
    sequence.maxGap = max(sequence.maxGap, right - left);
    sequence.minE1 = min(sequence.minE1, 2 * left - right);
    sequence.minE2 = min(sequence.minE2, left - 2 * right);
}

PointSequence appendSequences(const PointSequence& A,
                              const PointSequence& B) {
    if (A.empty) return B;
    if (B.empty) return A;

    PointSequence C;
    C.empty = false;
    C.first = A.first;
    C.last = B.last;
    C.maxGap = max(A.maxGap, B.maxGap);
    C.minE1 = min(A.minE1, B.minE1);
    C.minE2 = min(A.minE2, B.minE2);
    addEdgeExtremes(C, A.last, B.first);
    return C;
}

struct GapDescription {
    int64 c1 = 0;
    int64 c2 = 0;
    int64 maxGap = 0;
    int64 minE1 = INF;
    int64 minE2 = INF;

    Matrix matrix() const {
        Matrix result;
        int64 d = c2 - c1;

        result.a[0][0] = clampValue((i128)minE1 - c1 + d);
        result.a[0][1] = clampValue((i128)d - maxGap);
        result.a[1][0] = clampValue((i128)2 * d - 2 * (i128)maxGap);
        result.a[1][1] = clampValue((i128)d + minE2 + c1);
        return result;
    }
};

GapDescription describeGap(int64 c1, int64 c2,
                           const PointSequence& packages) {
    GapDescription gap;
    gap.c1 = c1;
    gap.c2 = c2;

    if (packages.empty) {
        addEdgeExtremes(gap, c1, c2);
    } else {
        gap.maxGap = packages.maxGap;
        gap.minE1 = packages.minE1;
        gap.minE2 = packages.minE2;
        addEdgeExtremes(gap, c1, packages.first);
        addEdgeExtremes(gap, packages.last, c2);
    }
    return gap;
}

struct Event {
    int64 quotient;
    int residueIndex;
    int delta;
    bool isCow;
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int64 M;
    int N, P;
    cin >> M >> N >> P;

    struct Interval {
        int64 residue;
        int64 firstQuotient;

    };

    vector<Interval> cows, packages;
    vector<int64> allResidues;

    int64 globalMinimum = LLONG_MAX;
