    i128 totalCows = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        int64 L, R;
        cin >> L >> R;
        int64 residue = L % M;
        int64 firstQuotient = L / M;
        int64 lastQuotient = R / M;

        cows.push_back({residue, firstQuotient, lastQuotient});
        allResidues.push_back(residue);
        globalMinimum = min(globalMinimum, L);
        globalMaximum = max(globalMaximum, R);
        totalCows += (i128)(lastQuotient - firstQuotient + 1);
    }

    int64 maximumQuotient = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < P; ++i) {
        int64 A, B;
        cin >> A >> B;
        int64 residue = A % M;
        int64 firstQuotient = A / M;
        int64 lastQuotient = B / M;

        packages.push_back({residue, firstQuotient, lastQuotient});
        allResidues.push_back(residue);
        globalMinimum = min(globalMinimum, A);
        globalMaximum = max(globalMaximum, B);
        maximumQuotient = max(maximumQuotient, lastQuotient);
    }

    for (const auto& cow : cows)
        maximumQuotient = max(maximumQuotient, cow.lastQuotient);

    if (totalCows == 1) {
        int64 cowPosition = 0;
        for (const auto& cow : cows) {
            cowPosition = min(cowPosition == 0 ? cow.firstQuotient * M + cow.residue
                                               : cowPosition,
                              cow.firstQuotient * M + cow.residue);
        }
        int64 answer = globalMaximum - globalMinimum
                     + min(cowPosition - globalMinimum,
                           globalMaximum - cowPosition);
        cout << answer << '\n';
        return 0;
    }

    sort(allResidues.begin(), allResidues.end());
    allResidues.erase(unique(allResidues.begin(), allResidues.end()),
                      allResidues.end());

    int residueCount = static_cast<int>(allResidues.size());
    vector<int> residueIndex(residueCount);
    for (int i = 0; i < residueCount; ++i)
        residueIndex[i] = i;

    auto getResidueIndex = [&](int64 residue) -> int {
        return lower_bound(allResidues.begin(), allResidues.end(), residue)
             - allResidues.begin();
    };

    vector<Event> events;
    for (const auto& cow : cows) {
        int index = getResidueIndex(cow.residue);
        events.push_back({cow.firstQuotient, index, +1, true});
        events.push_back({cow.lastQuotient + 1, index, -1, true});
    }
    for (const auto& package : packages) {
        int index = getResidueIndex(package.residue);
        events.push_back({package.firstQuotient, index, +1, false});
        events.push_back({package.lastQuotient + 1, index, -1, false});
    }

    sort(events.begin(), events.end(), [](const Event& A, const Event& B) {
        if (A.quotient != B.quotient) return A.quotient < B.quotient;
        return A.residueIndex < B.residueIndex;
    });

    vector<int> cowCount(residueCount, 0);
    vector<int> packageCount(residueCount, 0);
    vector<Matrix> incomingGap(residueCount, Matrix(true));

    PackageSegmentTree packageTree(residueCount);
    MatrixSegmentTree matrixTree(residueCount);

    set<int> activeCowIndices;

    auto matrixForCowGroup = [&](int index) -> Matrix {
        Matrix zero;
        zero.a[0][0] = zero.a[0][1] = zero.a[1][0] = zero.a[1][1] = 0;
        Matrix G = incomingGap[index];
        if (cowCount[index] <= 1) return G;
        return compose(G, zero);
    };

    auto updateCowLeaf = [&](int index) {
        matrixTree.setValue(index, matrixForCowGroup(index));
    };

    auto packageSequence = [&](const PackageSummary& summary,
                                int64 quotient) -> PointSequence {
        PointSequence sequence;
        if (summary.empty) return sequence;

        sequence.empty = false;
        sequence.first = quotient * M + summary.first;
        sequence.last = quotient * M + summary.last;
        sequence.maxGap = summary.maxGap;
        sequence.minE1 = clampValue((i128)summary.minE1 + (i128)quotient * M);
        sequence.minE2 = clampValue((i128)summary.minE2 - (i128)quotient * M);
        return sequence;
    };

    auto packageRange = [&](int left, int right, int64 quotient)
            -> PointSequence {
        if (left > right) return PointSequence();
        return packageSequence(packageTree.query(left, right), quotient);
    };

    auto refreshIncomingGap = [&](int index, int64 quotient) {
        auto it = activeCowIndices.find(index);
        if (it == activeCowIndices.end()) return;

        if (it == activeCowIndices.begin()) {
            incomingGap[index] = Matrix(true);
            updateCowLeaf(index);
            return;
        }

        auto previous = prev(it);
        int previousIndex = *previous;
        int currentIndex = *it;

        int left = upper_bound(allResidues.begin(), allResidues.end(),
                               allResidues[previousIndex])
                 - allResidues.begin();
        int right = upper_bound(allResidues.begin(), allResidues.end(),
                                allResidues[currentIndex])
                  - allResidues.begin() - 1;

        PointSequence sequence = packageRange(left, right, quotient);
        GapDescription gap = describeGap(
            quotient * M + allResidues[previousIndex],
            quotient * M + allResidues[currentIndex],
            sequence
        );
        incomingGap[currentIndex] = gap.matrix();
        updateCowLeaf(currentIndex);
    };

    auto refreshAfterPackageChange = [&](int index, int64 quotient) {
        auto it = activeCowIndices.find(index);
        if (it != activeCowIndices.end()) {
            refreshIncomingGap(index, quotient);
        } else {
            it = activeCowIndices.upper_bound(index);
            if (it != activeCowIndices.end())
                refreshIncomingGap(*it, quotient);
        }
    };

    auto internalGapDescription = [&](int previousIndex, int currentIndex,
                                      int64 quotient) -> GapDescription {
        int left = upper_bound(allResidues.begin(), allResidues.end(),
                               allResidues[previousIndex])
                 - allResidues.begin();
        int right = upper_bound(allResidues.begin(), allResidues.end(),
                                allResidues[currentIndex])
                  - allResidues.begin() - 1;

        PointSequence sequence = packageRange(left, right, quotient);
        return describeGap(
            quotient * M + allResidues[previousIndex],
            quotient * M + allResidues[currentIndex],
            sequence
        );
    };

    auto crossGapDescription = [&](int64 quotient,
                                    int64 lastResidue,
                                    int64 firstResidue) -> GapDescription {
        int trailingLeft = upper_bound(allResidues.begin(), allResidues.end(),
                                       lastResidue)
                         - allResidues.begin();
        int trailingRight = residueCount - 1;

        int leadingLeft = 0;
        int leadingRight = upper_bound(allResidues.begin(), allResidues.end(),
                                       firstResidue)
                         - allResidues.begin() - 1;

        PointSequence trailing = packageRange(trailingLeft, trailingRight,
                                              quotient);
        PointSequence leading = packageRange(leadingLeft, leadingRight,
                                             quotient + 1);
        PointSequence sequence = appendSequences(trailing, leading);

        return describeGap(
            quotient * M + lastResidue,
            (quotient + 1) * M + firstResidue,
            sequence
        );
    };

    auto leadingPackageSequence = [&](int64 quotient,
                                      int64 firstResidue) -> PointSequence {
        int right = upper_bound(allResidues.begin(), allResidues.end(),
                                firstResidue)
                  - allResidues.begin() - 1;
        return packageRange(0, right, quotient);
    };

    auto trailingPackageSequence = [&](int64 quotient,
                                        int64 lastResidue) -> PointSequence {
        int left = upper_bound(allResidues.begin(), allResidues.end(),
                               lastResidue)
                  - allResidues.begin();
        return packageRange(left, residueCount - 1, quotient);
    };

    auto fullRegionPackageSequence = [&](int64 quotient,
                                          int64 blockCount) -> PointSequence {
        if (activeCowIndices.empty() && packageTree.query(0, residueCount - 1).empty)
            return PointSequence();

        PackageSummary summary = packageTree.query(0, residueCount - 1);
        if (summary.empty) return PointSequence();

        PointSequence result;
        result.empty = false;
        result.first = quotient * M + summary.first;

        int64 lastQuotient = quotient + blockCount - 1;
        result.last = lastQuotient * M + summary.last;

        result.maxGap = summary.maxGap;
        result.minE1 = clampValue((i128)summary.minE1 + (i128)quotient * M);
        result.minE2 = clampValue((i128)summary.minE2 - (i128)lastQuotient * M);

        if (blockCount > 1) {
            int64 crossGap = M + summary.first - summary.last;
            int64 crossE1 = 2 * summary.last - (M + summary.first);
            int64 crossE2 = summary.last - 2 * (M + summary.first);

            result.maxGap = max(result.maxGap, crossGap);
            result.minE1 = min(result.minE1,
                               clampValue((i128)crossE1 + (i128)quotient * M));
            result.minE2 = min(result.minE2,
                               clampValue((i128)crossE2
                                        - (i128)(lastQuotient - 1) * M));
        }
        return result;
    };

    auto internalProduct = [&](int firstIndex, int lastIndex) -> Matrix {
        if (firstIndex > lastIndex) return Matrix(true);

        Matrix zero;
        zero.a[0][0] = zero.a[0][1] = zero.a[1][0] = zero.a[1][1] = 0;

        Matrix firstPart = Matrix(true);
        if (cowCount[firstIndex] > 1) firstPart = zero;

        Matrix suffix = matrixTree.query(firstIndex + 1, lastIndex);
        return compose(firstPart, suffix);
    };

    auto remainderAfterSecondGroup = [&](int secondIndex,
                                          int lastIndex) -> Matrix {
        Matrix zero;
        zero.a[0][0] = zero.a[0][1] = zero.a[1][0] = zero.a[1][1] = 0;

        Matrix firstPart = Matrix(true);
        if (cowCount[secondIndex] > 1) firstPart = zero;

        Matrix suffix = matrixTree.query(secondIndex + 1, lastIndex);
        return compose(firstPart, suffix);
    };

    auto specialInitialize = [&](const GapDescription& gap,
                                  int64 firstCow,
                                  int64 secondCow) -> State {
        int64 X = clampValue(min(
            (i128)firstCow - 2 * (i128)globalMinimum - gap.maxGap,
            -(i128)globalMinimum - firstCow + gap.minE1
        ));

        int64 Y = clampValue(min(
            (i128)firstCow - 2 * (i128)globalMinimum + secondCow + gap.minE2,
            -(i128)globalMinimum - firstCow + secondCow - 2 * (i128)gap.maxGap
        ));

        State state;
        state.x = clampValue((i128)X + secondCow);
        state.y = clampValue((i128)Y + secondCow);
        return state;
    };

    bool initialized = false;
    bool awaitingSecondCow = false;
    int64 firstCowPosition = 0;
    int64 currentCowPosition = 0;
    State state;
    PointSequence pendingPackages;

    size_t eventPosition = 0;
    while (eventPosition < events.size()) {
        int64 quotient = events[eventPosition].quotient;
        if (quotient > maximumQuotient) break;

        while (eventPosition < events.size()
               && events[eventPosition].quotient == quotient) {
            const Event& event = events[eventPosition++];
            if (event.isCow) {
                cowCount[event.residueIndex] += event.delta;
            } else {
                packageCount[event.residueIndex] += event.delta;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < residueCount; ++i) {
            if (packageCount[i] > 0) packageTree.setPresent(i, true);
            else packageTree.setPresent(i, false);
        }

        for (size_t i = 0; i < events.size(); ++i) {
            if (events[i].quotient != quotient) break;
            if (events[i].isCow) continue;
            refreshAfterPackageChange(events[i].residueIndex, quotient);
        }

        for (size_t i = 0; i < events.size(); ++i) {
            if (events[i].quotient != quotient) break;
            if (!events[i].isCow) continue;

            int index = events[i].residueIndex;
            bool nowPresent = cowCount[index] > 0;
            bool wasPresent = activeCowIndices.find(index)
                              != activeCowIndices.end();

            if (nowPresent && !wasPresent) {
                activeCowIndices.insert(index);
                incomingGap[index] = Matrix(true);
                refreshIncomingGap(index, quotient);

                auto next = activeCowIndices.upper_bound(index);
                if (next != activeCowIndices.end())
                    refreshIncomingGap(*next, quotient);
            } else if (!nowPresent && wasPresent) {
                activeCowIndices.erase(index);

                auto next = activeCowIndices.upper_bound(index);
                if (next != activeCowIndices.end())
                    refreshIncomingGap(*next, quotient);

                incomingGap[index] = Matrix(true);
                updateCowLeaf(index);
            } else if (nowPresent) {
                updateCowLeaf(index);
            }
        }

        int64 nextQuotient = maximumQuotient + 1;
        if (eventPosition < events.size())
            nextQuotient = events[eventPosition].quotient;

        int64 lastQuotient = min(maximumQuotient, nextQuotient - 1);
        if (quotient > lastQuotient) continue;

        int64 blockCount = lastQuotient - quotient + 1;

        if (activeCowIndices.empty()) {
            if (initialized || awaitingSecondCow) {
                pendingPackages = appendSequences(
                    pendingPackages,
                    fullRegionPackageSequence(quotient, blockCount)
                );
            }
            continue;
        }

        int firstIndex = *activeCowIndices.begin();
        int lastIndex = *activeCowIndices.rbegin();
        int64 firstResidue = allResidues[firstIndex];
        int64 lastResidue = allResidues[lastIndex];
        int64 firstCow = quotient * M + firstResidue;
        int64 lastCow = lastQuotient * M + lastResidue;

        Matrix P = internalProduct(firstIndex, lastIndex);
        GapDescription cross = crossGapDescription(quotient, lastResidue,
                                                   firstResidue);
        Matrix X = cross.matrix();
        Matrix U = compose(X, P);

        if (!initialized) {
            firstCowPosition = firstCow;
            auto second = activeCowIndices.upper_bound(firstIndex);

            if (cowCount[firstIndex] > 1) {
                GapDescription zeroGap;
                zeroGap.c1 = firstCow;
                zeroGap.c2 = firstCow;
                zeroGap.maxGap = 0;
                zeroGap.minE1 = firstCow;
                zeroGap.minE2 = -firstCow;

                state = specialInitialize(zeroGap, firstCow, firstCow);
                initialized = true;
                state = applyMatrix(P, state);
                currentCowPosition = lastCow;

                if (blockCount > 1)
                    state = applyMatrix(matrixPower(U, blockCount - 1), state);
            } else if (second != activeCowIndices.end()) {
                int secondIndex = *second;
                GapDescription firstGap = internalGapDescription(
                    firstIndex, secondIndex, quotient
                );

                state = specialInitialize(firstGap, firstCow,
                                          quotient * M + allResidues[secondIndex]);
                initialized = true;
                state = applyMatrix(
                    remainderAfterSecondGroup(secondIndex, lastIndex), state
                );
                currentCowPosition = lastCow;

                if (blockCount > 1)
                    state = applyMatrix(matrixPower(U, blockCount - 1), state);
            } else if (blockCount > 1) {
                state = specialInitialize(cross, firstCow,
                                          (quotient + 1) * M + firstResidue);
                initialized = true;
                state = applyMatrix(P, state);
                currentCowPosition = (quotient + 1) * M + lastResidue;

                if (blockCount > 2)
                    state = applyMatrix(matrixPower(U, blockCount - 2), state);
            } else {
                awaitingSecondCow = true;
                currentCowPosition = firstCow;
                pendingPackages = trailingPackageSequence(lastQuotient,
                                                           lastResidue);
                continue;
            }
        } else if (awaitingSecondCow) {
            pendingPackages = appendSequences(
                pendingPackages,
                leadingPackageSequence(quotient, firstResidue)
            );

            GapDescription firstGap = describeGap(firstCowPosition, firstCow,
                                                   pendingPackages);
            state = specialInitialize(firstGap, firstCowPosition, firstCow);
            initialized = true;
            awaitingSecondCow = false;

            state = applyMatrix(P, state);
            currentCowPosition = lastCow;

            if (blockCount > 1)
                state = applyMatrix(matrixPower(U, blockCount - 1), state);
        } else {
            pendingPackages = appendSequences(
                pendingPackages,
                leadingPackageSequence(quotient, firstResidue)
            );

            GapDescription gap = describeGap(currentCowPosition, firstCow,
                                              pendingPackages);
            state = applyMatrix(gap.matrix(), state);
            currentCowPosition = firstCow;

            state = applyMatrix(P, state);
            currentCowPosition = lastCow;

            if (blockCount > 1)
                state = applyMatrix(matrixPower(U, blockCount - 1), state);
        }

        pendingPackages = trailingPackageSequence(lastQuotient, lastResidue);
    }

    int64 answer = clampValue(min(
        (i128)globalMaximum + state.y - currentCowPosition,
        2 * (i128)globalMaximum + state.x - 2 * (i128)currentCowPosition
    ));

    cout << answer << '\n';
    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using int64 = long long;

static constexpr int S = 5;
static constexpr int64 INF = 4'000'000'000'000'000'000LL;

// States:
// 0: no working interval
// 1: interval open, cow not selected, left part will be traversed twice
// 2: interval open, cow not selected, right part will be traversed twice
// 3: cow selected, left part traversed twice
// 4: cow selected, right part traversed twice
static constexpr int64 RATE[S] = {0, 2, 1, 1, 2};

struct Matrix {
    int64 a[S][S];
};

static inline Matrix multiply(const Matrix& A, const Matrix& B) {
    Matrix C;
    for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j) {
            int64 v = INF;
            v = min(v, A.a[i][0] + B.a[0][j]);
            v = min(v, A.a[i][1] + B.a[1][j]);
            v = min(v, A.a[i][2] + B.a[2][j]);
            v = min(v, A.a[i][3] + B.a[3][j]);
            v = min(v, A.a[i][4] + B.a[4][j]);
            C.a[i][j] = v;
        }
    }
    return C;
}

using StateArray = array<int64, S>;

static inline StateArray applyMatrix(const Matrix& A, const StateArray& dp) {
    StateArray result;
    result.fill(INF);

    for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j) {
        int64 v = INF;
        v = min(v, dp[0] + A.a[0][j]);
        v = min(v, dp[1] + A.a[1][j]);
        v = min(v, dp[2] + A.a[2][j]);
        v = min(v, dp[3] + A.a[3][j]);
        v = min(v, dp[4] + A.a[4][j]);
        result[j] = v;
    }
    return result;
}

// Local actions at one coordinate:
//   open:   0 -> 1 or 0 -> 2
//   select: 1 -> 3 or 2 -> 4, consuming one cow
//   close:  3 -> 0 or 4 -> 0
//
// A package is covered if an open state occurs at its coordinate.
Matrix buildEventMatrix(bool hasCow, int cowLimit, bool hasPackage) {
    Matrix result;
    for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j)
            result.a[i][j] = INF;

    struct LocalState {
        int state;
        int used;
        bool sawOpen;
    };

    for (int start = 0; start < S; ++start) {
        bool visited[S][3][2] = {};
        queue<LocalState> q;

        LocalState initial{start, 0, start != 0};
        visited[start][0][initial.sawOpen] = true;
        q.push(initial);

        while (!q.empty()) {
            LocalState cur = q.front();
            q.pop();

            if (!hasPackage || cur.sawOpen) {
                result.a[start][cur.state] = 0;
            }

            auto push = [&](int state, int used, bool sawOpen) {
                if (!visited[state][used][sawOpen]) {
                    visited[state][used][sawOpen] = true;
                    q.push({state, used, sawOpen});
                }
            };

            // Open a new working interval.
            if (cur.state == 0) {
                push(1, cur.used, true);
                push(2, cur.used, true);
            }

            // Select the cow belonging to the current interval.
            if (hasCow && cur.used < cowLimit &&
                (cur.state == 1 || cur.state == 2)) {
                push(cur.state == 1 ? 3 : 4, cur.used + 1, true);
            }

            // Finish the current working interval.
            if (cur.state == 3 || cur.state == 4) {
                push(0, cur.used, cur.sawOpen);
            }
        }
    }

    return result;
}

// Indexed by [number of cows, category][whether a package is present].
// Cow categories are 0, 1, and 2 (meaning at least two).
Matrix EVENT[3][2];

struct SegmentTree {
    struct Node {
        int first = -1;
        int last = -1;
        Matrix matrix;

        Node() {
            for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j)
                    matrix.a[i][j] = INF;
        }
    };

    int size;
    vector<Node> tree;
    const vector<int64>& residues;

    SegmentTree(const vector<int64>& residues_) : residues(residues_) {
        size = 1;
        while (size < (int)residues.size()) size <<= 1;
        tree.resize(2 * size);
    }

    void pull(int p) {
        Node& cur = tree[p];
        const Node& left = tree[p << 1];
        const Node& right = tree[p << 1 | 1];

        if (left.first == -1) {
            cur = right;
            return;
        }
        if (right.first == -1) {
            cur = left;
            return;
        }

        int64 gap = residues[right.first] - residues[left.last];

        // Process the left events, then the gap, then the right events.
        Matrix shifted;
        for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j) {
                int64 v = left.matrix.a[i][j];
                shifted.a[i][j] =
                    (v >= INF ? INF : min(INF, v + RATE[j] * gap));
            }
        }

        cur.matrix = multiply(shifted, right.matrix);
        cur.first = left.first;
        cur.last = right.last;
    }

    void update(int index, int cowCategory, bool hasPackage) {
        int p = size + index;
        Node& leaf = tree[p];

        if (cowCategory == 0 && !hasPackage) {
            leaf.first = leaf.last = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i)
                for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j)
                    leaf.matrix.a[i][j] = INF;
        } else {
            leaf.first = leaf.last = index;
            leaf.matrix = EVENT[cowCategory][hasPackage ? 1 : 0];
        }

        for (p >>= 1; p; p >>= 1) pull(p);
    }

    const Node& root() const {
        return tree[1];
    }
};

struct Change {
    int64 cell;
    int residueIndex;
    int kind; // 0 = cow, 1 = package
    int delta;
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int64 M;
    int N, P;
    cin >> M >> N >> P;

    struct Interval {
        int64 L, R;
        int kind;
    };

    vector<Interval> intervals;
    intervals.reserve(N + P);
    vector<int64> residues;
    residues.reserve(N + P);

    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        int64 L, R;
        cin >> L >> R;
        intervals.push_back({L, R, 0});
        residues.push_back(L % M);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < P; ++i) {
        int64 A, B;
        cin >> A >> B;
        intervals.push_back({A, B, 1});
        residues.push_back(A % M);
    }

    sort(residues.begin(), residues.end());
    residues.erase(unique(residues.begin(), residues.end()), residues.end());

    int K = (int)residues.size();

    vector<Change> changes;
    changes.reserve(2 * intervals.size());

    int64 minCell = LLONG_MAX;
    int64 maxCell = 0;

    for (const auto& interval : intervals) {
        int64 firstCell = interval.L / M;
        int64 lastCell = interval.R / M;
        int residueIndex =
            lower_bound(residues.begin(), residues.end(), interval.L % M) -
            residues.begin();

        minCell = min(minCell, firstCell);
        maxCell = max(maxCell, lastCell);

        changes.push_back({firstCell, residueIndex, interval.kind, +1});
        changes.push_back({lastCell + 1, residueIndex, interval.kind, -1});
    }

    sort(changes.begin(), changes.end(),
         [](const Change& a, const Change& b) {
             return tie(a.cell, a.residueIndex, a.kind) <
                    tie(b.cell, b.residueIndex, b.kind);
         });

    for (int cows = 0; cows <= 2; ++cows) {
        for (int packages = 0; packages <= 1; ++packages) {
            EVENT[cows][packages] =
                buildEventMatrix(cows > 0, cows, packages == 1);
        }
    }

    SegmentTree seg(residues);
    vector<int> cowCount(K, 0), packageCount(K, 0);
    vector<int> leafCowCategory(K, 0);
    vector<char> leafHasPackage(K, false);

    StateArray dp;
    dp.fill(INF);
    dp[0] = 0;

    // Transition for one complete M-cell.
    auto cellMatrix = [&]() {
        Matrix result;
        for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i)
            for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j)
                result.a[i][j] = INF;

        const auto& root = seg.root();

        if (root.first == -1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) {
                result.a[i][i] = RATE[i] * M;
            }
        } else {
            int64 leadingGap = residues[root.first];
            int64 trailingGap = M - residues[root.last];

            for (int i = 0; i < S; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < S; ++j) {
                    int64 v = root.matrix.a[i][j];
                    if (v >= INF) {
                        result.a[i][j] = INF;
                    } else {
                        v = min(INF, v + RATE[i] * leadingGap);
                        v = min(INF, v + RATE[j] * trailingGap);
                        result.a[i][j] = v;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    };

    // Apply the same cell transition 'count' times.
    auto advance = [&](int64 count) {
        if (count <= 0) return;

        Matrix base = cellMatrix();

        if (count <= 16) {
            for (int64 t = 0; t < count; ++t) {
                dp = applyMatrix(base, dp);
            }
            return;
        }

        while (count > 0) {
            if (count & 1) dp = applyMatrix(base, dp);
            count >>= 1;
            if (count) base = multiply(base, base);
        }
    };

    int64 segmentStart = minCell;
    size_t pos = 0;

    while (pos < changes.size() && changes[pos].cell <= maxCell) {
        int64 cell = changes[pos].cell;
        vector<int> affected;
        affected.reserve(16);

        while (pos < changes.size() && changes[pos].cell == cell) {
            int residueIndex = changes[pos].residueIndex;

            while (pos < changes.size() &&
                   changes[pos].cell == cell &&
                   changes[pos].residueIndex == residueIndex) {
                const Change& change = changes[pos];
                if (change.kind == 0) {
                    cowCount[residueIndex] += change.delta;
                } else {
                    packageCount[residueIndex] += change.delta;
                }
                ++pos;
            }

            int newCategory = min(cowCount[residueIndex], 2);
            bool newHasPackage = packageCount[residueIndex] > 0;

            if (newCategory != leafCowCategory[residueIndex] ||
                newHasPackage != leafHasPackage[residueIndex]) {
                affected.push_back(residueIndex);
            }
        }

        if (!affected.empty()) {
            // The old active set applies to all cells before 'cell'.
            advance(cell - segmentStart);

            for (int index : affected) {
                int category = min(cowCount[index], 2);
                bool hasPackage = packageCount[index] > 0;

                seg.update(index, category, hasPackage);
                leafCowCategory[index] = category;
                leafHasPackage[index] = hasPackage;
            }

            segmentStart = cell;
        }
    }

    advance(maxCell + 1 - segmentStart);

    cout << dp[0] << '\n';
    return 0;
}
